notes: Use 分かる (wakaru) when something suddenly makes sense or you have gained information. This is different from 知る (shiru), which means 'to know' as in 'to have information stored in your memory.' If you have never heard of a person before, you don't 'know' (shiru) them; once you have learned their name, you 'know' (shiru) them.
When someone asks 'Do you understand?' they say 分かりますか? (Wakarimasu ka?). The negative is 分かりません (Wakarimasen) when you do not understand or do not know.
